_description: Cross-record registry of unknown FIT message types, keyed by manufacturer. Tracks what each proprietary message type number means, based on accumulated evidence across analysed files. Update this file alongside writing a new record whenever a message type is confirmed or a hypothesis is formed.

unknown_13.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (documented). Single occurrence per file — session-level training configuration block. Present across all activity types.

unknown_22.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Count varies by number of paired sensors: 6 in running-001 (HRM + other sensors), 4 in cycling-001 (HRM-Dual + others), 2 in indoorcycling-001 (HRM-Dual only), 1 in strength-001 (no external sensors). Confirms count reflects unique paired/active devices.

unknown_79.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Single occurrence per file across all activity types — session-level user physiological snapshot.

unknown_104.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Count varies: 9 in running-001, 11 in cycling-001, 8 in indoorcycling-001, 13 in strength-001. Count 13 in strength matches exercise_title count (13). Relationship to lap/exercise structure not fully resolved.

unknown_113.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Present only in running files; absent from cycling and strength. Consistent with personal best tracking for running distance segments.

unknown_140.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Single occurrence per file across all activity types — session-level activity metrics summary.

unknown_141.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). EPO = Extended Prediction Orbit (satellite data for faster GPS acquisition). Single occurrence per file. Present even for indoor/no-GPS activities.

unknown_147.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Single occurrence per file — sensor configuration block. Present across all activity types.

unknown_216.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Count varies widely by activity type: 20 in running, 5 in outdoor cycling, 3 in indoor cycling, 154 in strength. Strength count of 154 is far higher — possibly one per set per zone combination. Note: unrelated to session field def_num 216 (ending_body_battery).

unknown_233.hypothesis: Independent parallel data stream running at higher-than-record frequency. GPS-paired hypothesis DISPROVED: indoor_cycling file contains 2727 occurrences with no gps_metadata at all. Runs at approximately 3× record rate in indoor cycling. Purpose unknown — possibly raw sensor data (accelerometer, HRV, barometer) logged independently of activity record messages.
unknown_233.notes: Outdoor cycling: 3627 unknown_233 = 3627 gps_metadata (count coincidence). Indoor cycling: 2727 unknown_233, 0 gps_metadata. Strength: 3883 unknown_233. Neither fitparse nor FFV identifies this message type.

unknown_288.hypothesis: Count is consistently 2-3 across all file types (running, cycling, indoor cycling, strength). Not correlated with lap, set, or GPS structure. May be bookend markers for session phases or fixed Garmin internal state messages.
unknown_288.notes: Count: 3 in cycling-001, 2 in indoorcycling-001, 3 in strength-001. Consistent with prior running values. FFV does not identify.

unknown_312.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Absent from cycling and indoor cycling files — present only in running and strength. In strength, 76 occurrences likely correspond to individual sets. In running, corresponds to distance auto-splits. First strava-sourced occurrence (27 in a 17-lap hill repeats run) confirms this message type survives Strava's stripped re-encode even though almost every other proprietary message type does not — it is the only non-SDK message type present in that file.

unknown_313.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Absent from cycling files. Paired with unknown_312 (split). 3 occurrences in strength-001.

unknown_325.hypothesis: Sub-minute periodic metric. Outdoor cycling: 190 occurrences. Absent from indoor cycling and strength — may be GPS-dependent or outdoor-specific. Possible candidates: GPS quality snapshots, barometer readings, or outdoor environmental data.
unknown_325.notes: FFV does not identify. Present only in outdoor GPS activities. Absence from indoor cycling and strength narrows candidates to outdoor/GPS-dependent data.

unknown_326.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Count varies dramatically: 81 in outdoor cycling (~58 min), 49 in running (~49 min), 1 in indoor cycling, 1 in strength. High count in outdoor GPS activities; minimal in indoor/no-GPS modes. GPS event log.

unknown_327.hypothesis: Count consistently 3-5 across all file types including non-workout and strength. Not correlated with workout_step count. Purpose unknown.
unknown_327.notes: Count: 5 in cycling-001, 3 in indoorcycling-001, 3 in strength-001. Prior hypothesis that count matched workout_step count not supported across multiple file types. FFV does not identify.

unknown_394.notes: Named by FitFileViewer (undocumented). Single occurrence per file across all activity types.

unknown_499.hypothesis: Single occurrence — high message number suggests a newer Garmin firmware feature; unknown
unknown_499.notes: FFV does not identify. Present in outdoor cycling (absent from indoor cycling and strength). May be GPS or outdoor-specific.
